t: This LAP 2G switched socket functions as a reliable power outlet and integrated fast USB-C charger. Ideal for domestic kitchens and busy home offices, this unit powers household appliances whilst charging modern portable electronics. Dual Type-C ports provide up to twenty-two watts of shared power, ensuring rapid charging without occupying the primary plug sockets. The clean profile with colour-matched inserts blends seamlessly into any interior. Installers benefit from colour-coded angled in-line terminals and captive screws that simplify and speed up the wiring process.
